description: Record LaTeX edits, add comments, and accept or reject changes one at a time in VS Code.
configuration.title: LaTeX Review
configuration.uiLanguage: Language used for dynamic review controls. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
configuration.autoGoToNext: Move to the next change after accepting or rejecting the current change.
configuration.highlightChanges: Highlight the current change with a border and distinguish its new and old parameter text.
configuration.showReviewToolbar: Show the fixed review action bar in the status bar.
configuration.enableDefaultKeybindings: Enable the extension's default two-step keyboard shortcuts.
configuration.authorId: Optional identifier written to new change and comment macros; use letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.
command.markAddition: LaTeX Review: Mark Selection as Added
command.markDeletion: LaTeX Review: Mark Selection as Deleted
command.replaceWithRevision: LaTeX Review: Replace Selection with Revision
